props.name: defaultDifficulty
props.description: Difficulty of the first puzzle. The picker changes it after that.

props.name: puzzle
props.description: A fixed puzzle as 81 characters, row by row, with `0` or `.` for blanks. It must have exactly one solution. Leave it out to generate puzzles.

props.name: onSolve
props.description: Called once when the grid is filled correctly.
